<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.py from data/scenarios.json. Edit the JSON. -->

Run with `--cycle 240` to alternate healthy phases and these faults, or pin one with `--scenario NAME`. The alerts listed are the ones each fault is designed to trigger; thresholds are calibrated to the demo traffic.

### `tool-flaky`: Search / fetch dependency failing

**What changes:** `search` and `web_fetch` fail 35% of calls

**What you see**

- Tool error ratio by tool rises (search, web_fetch)
- Plan revisions (cause: tool_failure) and extra LLM calls
- Success rate falls; cost per task rises

**Alerts:** `AgentToolErrorRateHigh` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#tool-dependency-failing)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Tool error ratio by tool; Plan revisions
- TraceQL: `{ span.gen_ai.tool.name = "search" && status = error }`
- Logs: `|= "tool call failed"`

### `cost-spike`: Context bloat + revision cycles

**What changes:** Context x4, reviewer rejects 40% of drafts

**What you see**

- Cost per task spikes; p95 cost climbs
- Tasks end with `budget_exceeded` terminations
- Plan revisions (cause: rejected) and steps per task rise

**Alerts:** `AgentCostPerTaskSpike`, `AgentBudgetExceededTerminations` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#cost-spike)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Cost per task, Spend by agent, Terminations by reason
- TraceQL: `{ name = "invoke_agent supervisor" && span.app.task.termination_reason = "budget_exceeded" }`

### `injection`: Indirect prompt injection via tool output

**What changes:** 25% of `web_fetch` results carry injected instructions; 80% detected

**What you see**

- Guardrail events: `blocked` and `missed` (the `missed` ones are the dangerous ones)
- Write-tool approvals requested for `send_email`, some denied
- Warnings in logs; latency and cost unchanged

**Alerts:** `AgentInjectionMissed` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#safety--guardrail-incident)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Safety & governance row
- TraceQL: `{ span.tool.side_effect = "write" && span.approval.granted = false }`
- Logs: `|= "indirect prompt injection"`

### `slow-tool`: Tool latency regression

**What changes:** Tool latency x6

**What you see**

- Tool latency p95 and task duration p95 rise
- Some tasks hit the timeout
- Cost per task roughly unchanged

**Alerts:** `AgentTaskLatencyHigh` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#latency-regression)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Tool latency p95; Task duration
- TraceQL: `{ name = "invoke_agent supervisor" && duration > 30s }` and look for the long `execute_tool` span

### `runaway-loop`: Agent loop on repeated tool calls

**What changes:** 45% of tasks repeat the same search with the same arguments

**What you see**

- Loop detections; terminations with reason `loop` / `max_steps`
- Steps per task p95 climbs towards the hard limit
- Success rate falls; wasted cost

**Alerts:** `AgentLoopsDetected`, `AgentTaskSuccessLow` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#agent-runaway-or-loops)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Loop detections, Terminations by reason, Steps per task
- TraceQL: `{ span.loop.detected = true }` shows the repeated `tool.args_hash`
